# Amarnath Kumar - Portfolio

Professional portfolio of Amarnath Kumar, a Full-Stack Developer specializing in building responsive, scalable web applications across the frontend and backend.

## Navigation Links

- [Home](https://amarnathkumar.dev/) - Main page displaying featured projects, toolkit, and contact.
- [About](https://amarnathkumar.dev/about) - Personal background, skills, and professional highlights.
- [Projects](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects) - Comprehensive list of personal projects.
- [Contact](https://amarnathkumar.dev/contact) - Get in touch or connect via professional socials.
- [Resume](https://amarnathkumar.dev/resume) - View or download PDF resume.

## Key Projects

- [LeetLab](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects/leetlab) - Monaco-based coding platform with real-time execution via Judge0 and Gemini AI.
- [AuthCore](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects/authcore) - Secure authentication system with JWT, cookies, and rate limiting.
- [Connectify](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects/connectify) - A social networking product.
- [Finance Dashboard API](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects/finance-dashboard-api) - Backend API for a financial tracking dashboard.
- [SHE Foundation](https://amarnathkumar.dev/projects/she-foundation) - Internal platform for donor matching and rewards.

## Tech Stack & Skills

- **Frontend**: React, React Router, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Zustand, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL, REST APIs, JWT, Swagger
- **Tools & DevOps**: Docker, Postman, VS Code, Git, GitHub, Vercel, Render
